s0001.literal: In the fifteenth year, spring, first month, on xinmao day, Alawadin led troops to garrison Otgon and was granted three thousand shi of grain and thirty ingots of paper currency.
s0001.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on the xinmao day of the first month of spring, Alawadin led troops to garrison Otgon and received three thousand shi of grain and thirty ingots of paper currency.

s0002.literal: Because qianhu Zheng E had merit in battle, he was promoted to wanhu and granted a tiger tally.
s0002.idiomatic: Because qianhu Zheng E had won distinction in battle, he was promoted to wanhu and given a tiger tally.

s0003.literal: On guisi day the Western Capital suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve it, and Ahmad was instructed to store up widely against shortages.
s0003.idiomatic: On guisi day famine struck the Western Capital; ten thousand shi of grain were issued for relief, and Ahmad was told to build up reserves against future shortfalls.

s0004.literal: Shunde Prefecture prefect Zhang Wenhuan and Taiyuan Prefecture darughachi Tabuqa, after the surveillance commission exposed their corruption, sent men to the secretariat to confess, yet falsely charged the surveillance commission with crimes.
s0004.idiomatic: Shunde Prefecture prefect Zhang Wenhuan and Taiyuan Prefecture darughachi Tabuqa, once the surveillance commission had exposed their corruption, sent men to the secretariat to confess, then tried to shift the blame onto the surveillance commission.

s0005.literal: Censorate officials memorialized: "If the surveillance commission truly has guilt, they should not lodge charges because of this affair; Zhang Wenhuan's case should be decided first, and only then should their suit be heard.
s0005.idiomatic: Censorate officials memorialized, "If the surveillance commission is truly guilty, they ought not bring charges over this matter; Zhang Wenhuan's case should be decided first, and only then should their complaint be heard.

s0007.literal: On jihai day Yehsien, Koke Temür, and other officials who had rounded up stray property were pardoned for exchanging official horses and stray livestock; circuit, prefecture, and county civilian administrators were ordered jointly to take charge of the matter.
s0007.idiomatic: On jihai day Yehsien, Koke Temür, and other officials charged with rounding up stray property were pardoned for trading official horses and stray livestock; civilian administrators in the circuits, prefectures, and counties were ordered to take joint charge of the work.

s0008.literal: Officials who concealed property, exchanged horses without authorization, or privately assigned women had their households confiscated.
s0008.idiomatic: Officials who hid property, exchanged horses without authorization, or privately assigned women would have their households confiscated.

s0009.literal: Sale by officials, soldiers, and civilians of Jiangnan commoners' children they had taken as wives, or sale as prostitutes, was forbidden; buyers and sellers were both punished, the price confiscated by the state, and the persons restored to commoner status.
s0009.idiomatic: Officials, soldiers, and civilians were forbidden to sell Jiangnan commoners' children they had taken as wives or to sell them as prostitutes; buyers and sellers were both punished, the price was confiscated, and the persons were restored to commoner status.

s0010.literal: The Jinsha Spring in Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, was given the name Auspicious Response Spring.
s0010.idiomatic: Jinsha Spring in Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, was renamed Auspicious Response Spring.

s0011.literal: Jinsha Spring did not flow regularly; in Tang times this water was used to make Purple Bud tea for tribute; when officials prepared sacrificial victims and silks and offered sacrifice, water would appear, then dry up again when the rite ended.
s0011.idiomatic: Jinsha Spring did not flow steadily; in Tang times its water was used to make Purple Bud tea for tribute, and when officials prepared victims and silks and offered sacrifice, water would appear, only to dry up again once the rite was done.

s0012.literal: At the end of Song it was repeatedly dredged and repaired, yet the spring still would not flow.
s0012.idiomatic: Late in Song it was dredged and repaired again and again, but the spring still would not flow.

s0013.literal: At this time the Central Secretariat dispatched officials to offer sacrifice; overnight the water overflowed, sufficient to irrigate a thousand mu of fields.
s0013.idiomatic: Now the Central Secretariat sent officials to offer sacrifice, and overnight the water overflowed, enough to irrigate a thousand mu of fields.

s0014.literal: The pacification commission reported the matter, and for this reason the present name was granted.
s0014.idiomatic: The pacification commission reported what had happened, and for that reason the present name was granted.

s0015.literal: The god Lord Cui of Cizhou Prefecture was enfeoffed as King Qisheng of Broad Aid.
s0015.idiomatic: The god Lord Cui of Cizhou Prefecture was enfeoffed as King Qisheng of Broad Aid.

s0016.literal: On renyin day the wine prohibition was lifted for Jurchen and Suiban peoples.
s0016.idiomatic: On renyin day the wine ban was lifted for the Jurchen and Suiban peoples.

s0017.literal: On bingwu day the Anxi Prince's chancellor's office reported: "Wanhu Tuman Dar and Hao Jalabuhua and others captured Luzhou and beheaded its commanders Wang Shichang and Commander Li.
s0017.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Anxi Prince's chancellor's office reported that wanhu Tuman Dar and Hao Jalabuhua and others had taken Luzhou and beheaded its commanders Wang Shichang and Commander Li.

s0018.literal: " On wushen day, granting Ahmad's request, from now on the Censorate was not to summon warehouse clerks without informing the Secretariat, nor investigate cash and grain accounts; those who failed to attend joint deliberations at the Central Secretariat would be punished.
s0018.idiomatic: On wushen day, granting Ahmad's request, the Censorate was forbidden from now on to summon warehouse clerks without notifying the Secretariat or to investigate cash and grain accounts; those absent from joint deliberations at the Central Secretariat would be punished.

s0019.literal: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui was appointed honorary golden-bright grand master of the palace, titular minister of grand granaries, and Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.
s0019.idiomatic: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui was made honorary golden-bright grand master of the palace, titular minister of grand granaries, and Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.

s0020.literal: On gengxu day East Sichuan deputy commander-in-chief Zhang Derun greatly defeated Fuzhou troops, beheading prefectural commander Wang Ming and his son Zhongxun, zongguan Han Wenguang, and Zhang Yuchun.
s0020.idiomatic: On gengxu day East Sichuan deputy commander-in-chief Zhang Derun routed the troops of Fuzhou, beheading prefectural commander Wang Ming and his son Zhongxun, zongguan Han Wenguang, and Zhang Yuchun.

s0021.literal: An edict ordered that military officers who could not keep discipline among their soldiers, or whose corvée abuses drove men to desert, would have half their household goods confiscated.
s0021.idiomatic: An edict declared that officers who failed to keep their soldiers in order, or whose corvée abuses drove men to desert, would forfeit half their household goods.

s0022.literal: Anige was made grand steward and also placed in charge of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.
s0022.idiomatic: Anige was made grand steward and placed in charge of the Directorate of Palace Buildings as well.

s0023.literal: Second month, on wuwu day, sacrifice was offered to the First Farmer.
s0023.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu day, sacrifice was offered to the First Farmer.

s0024.literal: Mongol princely sons performed the plowing rite in the ceremonial field in their stead.
s0024.idiomatic: Mongol princely sons performed the ceremonial plowing in their stead.

s0025.literal: On guihai day Xianchun Prefecture and other commanderies and the common households of Daliang suffered famine; one thousand ingots of paper currency were issued to relieve them.
s0025.idiomatic: On guihai day famine struck Xianchun Prefecture and other commanderies and the common households of Daliang; one thousand ingots of paper currency were issued for relief.

s0026.literal: Grand councillors Atahai and Ari were ordered to select capable and honest officials in Jiangnan and remove redundant and incompetent ones.
s0026.idiomatic: Grand councillors Atahai and Ari were ordered to choose capable and honest officials in Jiangnan and remove redundant and unfit ones.

s0027.literal: Wanquan County in Hezhong Prefecture was re-established.
s0027.idiomatic: Wanquan County in Hezhong Prefecture was restored.

s0028.literal: On xinwei day, because Sichuan lands were much afflicted by miasma, the wine prohibition was lifted.
s0028.idiomatic: On xinwei day the wine ban was lifted in Sichuan, where miasma was widespread.

s0029.literal: On dingchou day Mars transited Celestial Street.
s0029.idiomatic: On dingchou day Mars transited Celestial Street.

s0030.literal: On gengchen day soldiers of Bieshibali called up for campaign were exempted from corvée.
s0030.idiomatic: On gengchen day soldiers of Bieshibali called up for campaign were exempted from corvée.

s0031.literal: On renwu day associate administrator and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Sudu led troops to attack Chaozhou and took it.
s0031.idiomatic: On renwu day associate administrator and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Sudu led troops against Chaozhou and captured it.

s0032.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was established; crown prince tutor Wang Xun was ordered to direct it, Works Ministry langzhong Guo Shoujing to assist him, and Academician-Grand Councillor and concurrent National University chancellor Xu Heng to oversee it.
s0032.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was established; crown prince tutor Wang Xun was put in charge, Works Ministry langzhong Guo Shoujing was made his deputy, and Academician-Grand Councillor and concurrent National University chancellor Xu Heng was placed over the whole office.

s0033.literal: Huating County was changed to Songjiang Prefecture.
s0033.idiomatic: Huating County was upgraded to Songjiang Prefecture.

s0034.literal: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.
s0034.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.

s0035.literal: Associate administrators Xia Gui, Fan Wenhu, and Chen Yan were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Huangzhou Circuit pacification commissioner Tangudai and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators.
s0035.idiomatic: Associate administrators Xia Gui, Fan Wenhu, and Chen Yan were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat, and Huangzhou Circuit pacification commissioner Tangudai and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators.

s0036.literal: Third month, on yiyou day, an edict ordered Mangudai, Sudu, and Pu Shougeng to conduct branch secretariat affairs at Fuzhou and pacify the coastal commanderies.
s0036.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou day, an edict ordered Mangudai, Sudu, and Pu Shougeng to run branch secretariat affairs at Fuzhou and pacify the coastal commanderies.

s0037.literal: Coastal frontier deputy commissioner Heladai was placed in command of the fleet for the southern campaign; he was promoted to frontier commissioner and concurrent left deputy commander-in-chief and granted a tiger tally.
s0037.idiomatic: Coastal frontier deputy commissioner Heladai was put in command of the fleet for the southern campaign, promoted to frontier commissioner and concurrent left deputy commander-in-chief, and given a tiger tally.

s0038.literal: On dinghai day the moon invaded Venus.
s0038.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon invaded Venus.

s0039.literal: On wuzi day the moon invaded Mars.
s0039.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon invaded Mars.

s0040.literal: On jichou day the branch secretariat requested to audit the mobile censorate's documents; this was not granted.
s0040.idiomatic: On jichou day the branch secretariat asked to audit the mobile censorate's documents; the request was denied.

s0041.literal: On jiawu day the Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Western Shu, Chongqing, and other places, yielding three prefectures, six subprefectures, one army, one directorate, twenty counties, forty stockades, and one barbarian domain.
s0041.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Western Shu, Chongqing, and other places, yielding three prefectures, six subprefectures, one army, one directorate, twenty counties, forty stockades, and one barbarian domain.

s0042.literal: On yiwei day Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing sent Ni Jian with a memorial to court and ordered him to await orders at the capital.
s0042.idiomatic: On yiwei day Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing sent Ni Jian with a memorial to court and told him to await orders at the capital.

s0043.literal: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to select troops from Temür Buqa's command to assist the advance against Longxing.
s0043.idiomatic: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to choose troops from Temür Buqa's command to help the advance against Longxing.

s0044.literal: On dingyou day Tachai was ordered to destroy the walls of Kuizhou Prefecture.
s0044.idiomatic: On dingyou day Tachai was ordered to tear down the walls of Kuizhou Prefecture.

s0045.literal: On wuxu day Liu Zongchun held Deqing Prefecture; Wuzhou wanhu Zhu Guobao attacked him, burned his stockades and palisades, and then took Deqing.
s0045.idiomatic: On wuxu day Liu Zongchun held Deqing Prefecture; Wuzhou wanhu Zhu Guobao attacked him, burned his stockades and palisades, and captured Deqing.

s0046.literal: An edict ordered left associate Lü Wenhuan to dispatch officials to recruit Song raw and seasoned ticket soldiers; those fit for service were to receive monthly pay and rations;
s0046.idiomatic: An edict ordered left associate Lü Wenhuan to send officials to recruit raw and seasoned ticket soldiers of Song; those fit for service were to receive monthly pay and rations;

s0047.literal: those unfit were to be given oxen for garrison farming.
s0047.idiomatic: those unfit were to be given oxen for garrison farming.

s0048.literal: On gengzi day Han army commander-in-chief Li Ting volunteered to lead troops against Zhang Shijie; this was granted.
s0048.idiomatic: On gengzi day Han army commander-in-chief Li Ting volunteered to lead troops against Zhang Shijie, and the request was granted.

s0049.literal: The Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Yisheng, Tuhui, and other cities and Shiliu Stockade, which submitted in succession.
s0049.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Yisheng, Tuhui, and other cities and Shiliu Stockade, which surrendered one after another.

s0050.literal: On renyin day, because harvests had failed year after year in the circuits, this year's field rent and silk tax were remitted.
s0050.idiomatic: On renyin day, because harvests had failed year after year across the circuits, this year's field rent and silk tax were remitted.

s0051.literal: On guimao day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an dispatched troops to capture Shaoqing, seized its prefect Xian Long, and ordered him beheaded.
s0051.idiomatic: On guimao day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an sent troops to take Shaoqing, seized its prefect Xian Long, and had him beheaded.

s0052.literal: On yisi day the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission dispatched garrison commander Cui Yong, qianhu Liu Tan, and Wang Deyong to win over Lei, Hua, and Gao prefectures, and Yong and the others were left to garrison them.
s0052.idiomatic: On yisi day the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission sent garrison commander Cui Yong, qianhu Liu Tan, and Wang Deyong to win over Lei, Hua, and Gao prefectures, and Yong and his party were left to garrison them.

s0053.literal: Song's Zhang Shijie and Su Liuyi took Prince Guang Zhao Bing and fled to Yaizhou.
s0053.idiomatic: Song's Zhang Shijie and Su Liuyi took Prince Guang Zhao Bing and fled to Yaizhou.

s0054.literal: Associate administrators Milhuxin and Zhang Shouzhi were both ordered to conduct Ministry of Revenue affairs.
s0054.idiomatic: Associate administrators Milhuxin and Zhang Shouzhi were both placed in charge of Ministry of Revenue affairs.

s0055.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, commander Liu Guojie was ordered to lead ten thousand men on a northern campaign, and the officers and soldiers were granted twenty thousand six hundred seventy-one ingots of paper currency.
s0055.idiomatic: In summer, on the yimao day of the fourth month, commander Liu Guojie was ordered to lead ten thousand men north, and the officers and soldiers received 20,671 ingots of paper currency.

s0056.literal: The Temple of King Pangu in Huichuan County was repaired and sacrifice was offered there.
s0056.idiomatic: The Temple of King Pangu in Huichuan County was repaired and sacrifice was offered there.

s0057.literal: On bingchen day an edict ordered that because Yunnan's territory was vast and many places had not yet submitted, ten thousand men were to be levied for a punitive campaign.
s0057.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered ten thousand men levied for a punitive campaign, because Yunnan's territory was vast and many places had not yet submitted.

s0058.literal: On wuwu day, because bandits had broken out in Jiangnan and hearts were still unsettled, left associate Xia Gui and others of the branch secretariat were ordered to pacify soldiers and civilians by separate routes and audit cash and grain;
s0058.idiomatic: On wuwu day, because bandits had broken out in Jiangnan and the people were still unsettled, branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui and others were ordered to pacify soldiers and civilians along separate routes and audit cash and grain;

s0059.literal: to investigate commanderies and counties severely afflicted by drought and officials who were honest and capable, and report them;
s0059.idiomatic: to look into commanderies and counties hard hit by drought and officials who were honest and capable, and report them;

s0060.literal: and to impeach and dismiss those who were greedy, cruel, and unfit for office.
s0060.idiomatic: and to impeach and remove those who were greedy, cruel, and unfit for office.

s0061.literal: On jiazi day Buqa was ordered to remain and garrison Western Sichuan; Wang Weizheng led meritorious Mongol and Han army officers and surrendered officials to audience; the capital patrol troops garrisoning Western Sichuan were sent back.
s0061.idiomatic: On jiazi day Buqa was ordered to remain and garrison Western Sichuan; Wang Weizheng led meritorious Mongol and Han army officers and surrendered officials to audience; the capital patrol troops garrisoning Western Sichuan were sent home.

s0062.literal: Transport commissions were established in Yunnan and Hunan.
s0062.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established in Yunnan and Hunan.

s0063.literal: Because timely rain had fallen in full measure, the wine prohibition was slightly relaxed; for common people weakened by age or illness who drank medicine, the state was to brew and measure out supplies.
s0063.idiomatic: Because the timely rains had been ample, the wine ban was partly relaxed; for common people weakened by age or illness who needed wine for medicine, the state would brew and ration supplies.

s0064.literal: On xinwei day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrificial Victuals was established, with concurrent vice-director of the Imperial Household Directorate Tula Temür as director of imperial sacrificial victuals.
s0064.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrificial Victuals was established, with concurrent vice-director of the Imperial Household Directorate Tula Temür as its director.

s0065.literal: Zhang Zhensun of Guangzhou rebelled and attacked Guangzhou; the defending commander Zhang Xiongfei abandoned the city and fled; troops were sent against him; Zhensun begged to surrender and was ordered to send Zhensun and his wife to the capital.
s0065.idiomatic: Zhang Zhensun of Guangzhou rebelled and attacked the city; defending commander Zhang Xiongfei abandoned it and fled; troops were sent against him; Zhensun begged to surrender and was ordered to send himself and his wife to the capital.

s0066.literal: On dingchou day the Yunnan branch secretariat won over one hundred nine stockaded towns in the Lin'an, Baiyi, and Heni partitioned lands, thirty-two thousand two hundred soldiers and civilians in the Weichu, Jinchi, and Luoluo partitioned stockades, and nineteen stockaded towns of the Tulaoman, Gaozhou, and Junlianzhou.
s0066.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Yunnan branch secretariat won over 109 stockaded towns in the Lin'an, Baiyi, and Heni partitioned lands, 32,200 soldiers and civilians in the Weichu, Jinchi, and Luoluo partitioned stockades, and 19 stockaded towns of the Tulaoman, Gaozhou, and Junlianzhou.

s0067.literal: On gengchen day, on Xu Heng's recommendation, envoys were sent to Hangzhou and other places to bring official books and carved blocks to the capital.
s0067.idiomatic: On gengchen day, on Xu Heng's recommendation, envoys were sent to Hangzhou and other places to bring official books and printing blocks to the capital.

s0068.literal: On renwu day a branch secretariat was established at Jiankang Prefecture.
s0068.idiomatic: On renwu day a branch secretariat was established at Jiankang Prefecture.

s0069.literal: Left associate Cui Bin memorialized: "Recently, because Jiangnan offices were redundant and appointments went to unworthy men, Ari and others were ordered to purge them, yet Ahmad, sunk in private favoritism, installed his own kin throughout his household in key posts.
s0069.idiomatic: Left associate Cui Bin memorialized, "Recently, because Jiangnan offices were bloated and appointments went to unworthy men, Ari and others were ordered to purge them, yet Ahmad, sunk in private favoritism, had installed his own kin throughout his household in key posts.

s0071.literal: He also memorialized: "Alawadin was impeached by censorate officials for embezzling official funds, and the case is still unfinished; now he is again appointed associate administrator of Jiang-Huai — this cannot be allowed.
s0071.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "Censorate officials had impeached Alawadin for embezzling official funds, and the case was still unfinished; now he was again appointed associate administrator of Jiang-Huai — that could not stand.

s0073.literal: An edict ordered that from now on dismissed officials would step down one rank: grand councillors to pacification commissioners, pacification commissioners to circuit officials, and circuit officials to prefectural officials.
s0073.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on dismissed officials would step down one rank: grand councillors to pacification commissioners, pacification commissioners to circuit officials, and circuit officials to prefectural officials.

s0074.literal: Huai and Zhe salt revenues were placed directly under the branch secretariat; pacification commissioners were not to intervene.
s0074.idiomatic: Huai and Zhe salt revenues were placed directly under the branch secretariat, and pacification commissioners were not to intervene.

s0075.literal: The Northern Capital branch secretariat was changed to a pacification commission.
s0075.idiomatic: The Northern Capital branch secretariat was converted to a pacification commission.

s0076.literal: Tiger tallies held by Jiangnan artisan officials were recalled.
s0076.idiomatic: Tiger tallies held by Jiangnan artisan officials were recalled.

s0077.literal: Fifth month, on guwei new moon day, an edict instructed Hanlin academician Horeqosun that in future appointments of grand councillors and chief military ministers, they were to consult together with elderly Confucian officials.
s0077.idiomatic: On the guwei new moon of the fifth month, an edict instructed Hanlin academician Horeqosun that in future appointments of grand councillors and chief military ministers, he was to consult together with elderly Confucian officials.

s0078.literal: On yiyou day the branch secretariat reported: "Recently, in suppressing the cliff-cave stockades of Shaowu, Jianchang, Ji, and Fu, Nie Laolao and Dai Xunzi were captured and the rest of the band submitted.
s0078.idiomatic: On yiyou day the branch secretariat reported, "Recently, in suppressing the cliff-cave stockades of Shaowu, Jianchang, Ji, and Fu, Nie Laolao and Dai Xunzi were captured and the rest of the band submitted.

s0079.literal: Only Zhang Shijie held Yaizhou, attacked neighboring commanderies, and was not easily subdued; it was proposed to dispatch pacification commissioner Shi Ge for a punitive campaign.
s0079.idiomatic: Only Zhang Shijie held Yaizhou, raided neighboring commanderies, and was not easily subdued; it was proposed to send pacification commissioner Shi Ge against him.

s0080.literal: " An edict placed Yesu Haiya in overall command.
s0080.idiomatic: " An edict placed Yesu Haiya in overall command.

s0081.literal: An edict ordered: "If a chief military officer has already received a new appointment, his old post should be given separately to one who has merit; it must not again pass to his sons and grandsons by inheritance.
s0081.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "If a chief military officer has already received a new appointment, his old post should be given separately to one who has merit; it must not pass again to his sons and grandsons by inheritance.

s0082.literal: " The prohibitions against unregistered soldiers' plunder and against hired slaves serving in the army were strictly enforced.
s0082.idiomatic: The bans on plunder by unregistered soldiers and on hired slaves serving in the army were strictly enforced.

s0083.literal: On jiawu day, when officials of every rank committed crimes, those appointed by rescript were reported to the throne; those appointed by edict were handled by the mobile censorate; those appointed by secretariat dispatch were tried by the surveillance commission.
s0083.idiomatic: On jiawu day, when officials of every rank committed crimes, those appointed by rescript were reported to the throne; those appointed by edict were handled by the mobile censorate; those appointed by secretariat dispatch were tried by the surveillance commission.

s0084.literal: For pacification commission officials guilty of wickedness, violation, or irregular documents and dossiers, the circuit surveillance commission was to review and correct them.
s0084.idiomatic: For pacification commission officials guilty of wickedness, violation, or irregular documents and dossiers, the circuit surveillance commission was to review and correct them.

s0085.literal: In cases warranting death, after the responsible office had examined the matter clearly and the circuit surveillance commission had reviewed it and found no injustice, judgment was to be passed according to regulation.
s0085.idiomatic: In capital cases, after the responsible office had examined the matter clearly and the circuit surveillance commission had reviewed it and found no injustice, judgment was to be passed according to regulation.

s0086.literal: Cases were grouped and submitted awaiting command.
s0086.idiomatic: Cases were grouped and submitted awaiting command.

s0087.literal: For public business from the branch secretariat downward, small matters were limited to seven days, medium matters to fifteen days, and great matters to thirty days.
s0087.idiomatic: For public business from the branch secretariat downward, small matters were limited to seven days, medium matters to fifteen days, and great matters to thirty days.

s0088.literal: Crack Jiangnan troops were selected for the Palace Guard.
s0088.idiomatic: Crack troops from Jiangnan were chosen for the Palace Guard.

s0089.literal: On yiwei day Wumeng Circuit was placed under the Yunnan branch secretariat; an edict also instructed Wumeng Circuit prefect Amu to establish relay stations and repair roads, and all affairs were to be directed by branch secretariat grand councillor Sayid Ajall.
s0089.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wumeng Circuit was placed under the Yunnan branch secretariat; an edict also instructed Wumeng Circuit prefect Amu to establish relay stations and repair roads, and all affairs were to be directed by branch secretariat grand councillor Sayid Ajall.

s0090.literal: Water relay stations were established in Sichuan, running from Xuzhou to Jingnan Prefecture.
s0090.idiomatic: Water relay stations were established in Sichuan from Xuzhou to Jingnan Prefecture.

s0091.literal: On jihai day Jiangdong Circuit surveillance commissioner Abaqa sought gold and silver vessels and dwelling houses with women and children from Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan and did not obtain them, then falsely charged him with privately hiding arms.
s0091.idiomatic: On jihai day Jiangdong Circuit surveillance commissioner Abaqa sought gold and silver vessels and dwelling houses with women and children from Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan, failed to get them, and then falsely charged him with privately hiding arms.

s0092.literal: An edict ordered mobile censorate chief Xiangwei to investigate; when the matter was cleared, Abaqa was dismissed from office.
s0092.idiomatic: An edict ordered mobile censorate chief Xiangwei to investigate; when the truth came out, Abaqa was dismissed from office.

s0093.literal: On xinhai day Zhang Liusun was appointed by decree chief prelate of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.
s0093.idiomatic: On xinhai day Zhang Liusun was appointed by decree chief prelate of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.

s0094.literal: The officers of the Palace Guard Office and the four hundred fifty men under their command were granted two thousand sixty ingots of paper currency.
s0094.idiomatic: The officers of the Palace Guard Office and the 450 men under their command received 2,060 ingots of paper currency.

s0095.literal: Sixth month, on yimao day, the Western Tibet Li Tang city was changed to Li Tang Prefecture.
s0095.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao day, the Western Tibet Li Tang city was upgraded to Li Tang Prefecture.

s0096.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered that Bo'erchi, Darqchi, and officials of the grain and coin offices were not to be granted tallies; those already granted were to be recalled.
s0096.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered that Bo'erchi, Darqchi, and officials of the grain and coin offices were not to receive tallies; those already granted were to be recalled.

s0097.literal: On renxu day surrendered officials of Luzhou including Xue Wang and others were granted paper currency in varying amounts.
s0097.idiomatic: On renxu day surrendered officials of Luzhou including Xue Wang and others received paper currency in varying amounts.

s0098.literal: On bingyin day, because the thirteen frontier passes in Jiangnan were overstaffed, one honest and capable military-civilian official was chosen for each to take charge.
s0098.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because the thirteen frontier passes in Jiangnan were overstaffed, one honest and capable military-civilian official was chosen to take charge of each.

s0099.literal: Jinan Prefecture was promoted to Jinan Circuit, and Xiliang Prefecture was reduced to Xiliang subprefecture.
s0099.idiomatic: Jinan Prefecture was promoted to Jinan Circuit, and Xiliang Prefecture was demoted to Xiliang subprefecture.

s0100.literal: On dingmao day a He-di Purchase and Relief Office was established in Ganzhou to supply army rations and relieve the poor.
s0100.idiomatic: On dingmao day a He-di Purchase and Relief Office was established in Ganzhou to supply army rations and relieve the poor.
